The notable uptick in REIT involvement reflects a strategic move, as anticipated rental hikes in key markets create further opportunities for portfolio growth.

title: TCS techie on way home dies after reversing JCB rams his bike in Gurgaon

Tushar Kumar was returning home from his work at Tata Consultancy Services. His father alleged the road work lacked proper directions and indicators. Police have seized the earthmover and are examining the allegations.

This high-tech zapper targets various mosquito types while sparing other insects. The outdoor version costs $1,088, and the indoor model is priced at $988. This chemical-free solution offers a novel approach to mosquito control.

title: SIMs, WhatsApp, Dubai route: How Delhi couple aided Pakistan-linked espionage

They procured and sent eight SIM cards to Pakistan via Dubai for payment.  Sahil was also tasked with recruiting individuals for reconnaissance and gathering military information.  Forensic evidence from seized phones linked them directly to foreign handlers.

The board asserts that its electoral procedures must reflect its constitution, challenging the government's notice that allows for elections to be postponed until December 2026. This discord highlights key issues surrounding cooling-off periods for officials and conflict of interest regulations, clouding the governance framework across various state cricket bodies.

title: Pak drone detected in J&K's Poonch, security forces put LoC sector on high alert
description: Security forces are on high alert after a Pakistani drone was detected near the LoC.  Military personnel tracked the unmanned aerial vehicle over the Rajouri sector on Friday evening.  This incident follows several other suspected drone sightings reported in Jammu and Kashmir recently.  Security forces have intensified search operations in forward areas to detect any dropped materials.  Border monitoring remains active as authorities await further official updates on the situation.

title: 'He keeps faking injuries': Ex-Pak chief selector's allegation against Imam
description: Former chief selector Mohammad Wasim has claimed that Imam-ul-Haq has a history of faking injuries. During the recent Lord's Test match, Imam-ul-Haq sustained a calf injury that scans later confirmed to be a low-grade strain, sidelining him from the game. Meanwhile, Pakistan continues to face challenges in the ongoing Test series as England's pace bowlers exerted authority over Pakistan's batting lineup.

title: CNG price hike: Compressed natural gas gets costlier; check city-wise rates
description: Consumers in Delhi and surrounding areas brace for higher compressed natural gas prices as Indraprastha Gas Limited implements a price hike due to escalating imported liquefied natural gas costs. Effective August 29, this change is linked to surging international LNG prices and ongoing Middle East conflicts, impacting both freight and passenger fares in the region, following several prior increases.

title: ‘India messed up big time’: Ex-captain sounds alarm after costly Colombo blunder
description: India's ambitions for World Test Championship qualification took a blow following a drawn Test match in Colombo. This result denied them a chance to sweep the series against Sri Lanka. Cricketer Krishnamachari Srikkanth expressed concerns about the implications for the team's future. With only seven matches left, India must secure victories in at least six to stay in contention for the title.

title: Delhi model murder: Accused Imran was booked for sexually harassing minor in 2018
description: A gym trainer accused of murdering a young woman was injured in a police encounter. He opened fire at officers while resisting arrest in Rajouri Garden. Police retaliated, and three bullets struck the suspect in his legs. Investigators are probing his social media activity and past criminal cases. The suspect had allegedly harassed the victim before her death.

title: Bangladeshi illegal who broke into Saif Ali Khan’s home & knifed him pleads guilty
description: Shariful Islam, accused in the Saif Ali Khan attack, has pleaded guilty. He seeks leniency from the court after charges were framed. The accused is facing severe charges for armed robbery and attempted grievous hurt. Islam illegally entered India and attacked the actor and others with a weapon. His fingerprints and DNA evidence link him to the crime scene.

description: On August 29, National Sports Day commemorates Major Dhyan Chand, the iconic figure in Indian hockey whose brilliance led to three Olympic gold medals. This day not only celebrates his legacy, but also promotes the spirit of sportsmanship, fitness, and healthy living among the youth, as well as acknowledging the accolades of India's sports heroes, fueling inspiration for future generations.

title: How Naomi Osaka overcame mental battles and motherhood to make a comeback
description: Naomi Osaka’s tennis comeback is about much more than Grand Slam titles. After speaking openly about her mental health and becoming a mother to daughter Shai in 2023, she slowly rebuilt her career. Now ranked No. 13, Osaka is competing deep into major tournaments again. Her journey shows how family, patience and self-belief can change an athlete’s idea of success.

England ended the second day in a strong position.

However, it managed to cross the Rs 150 crore net mark in India.  Its worldwide gross collection now stands at Rs 221.45 crore after three days.  The Geetu Mohandas directorial has garnered significant attention from audiences.

He announced the agreement in a social media post. The announcement comes almost nine months after the US military, acting on Trump's orders, carried out an operation to capture Venezuela's President Nicolás Maduro. Maduro was taken to the US to face federal charges related to narcoterrorism, drug trafficking.

description: Junk foods will soon feature prominent red warning labels on their packaging. These labels will highlight high levels of salt, sugar, and fat content. The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has agreed to this new regulation. This move aims to help consumers make more informed purchasing decisions. The phased implementation will allow the industry time to adjust product formulations.

In response, Penguin emphasized its commitment to editorial integrity and its role in verifying facts. They remain open to publishing the memoir in India, but uncertainties linger surrounding the rights for its release in the country.

The Chief Minister stressed the importance of reading and ensuring prisoners receive adequate books. He inspected prison facilities, including the kitchen and medical areas. The visit followed assembly discussions on prison department grant demands.
